115cf142b0a2b1fc.name: aria-activedescendant
115cf142b0a2b1fc.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

acbc47e66317ea8b.name: aria-atomic
acbc47e66317ea8b.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

cc01e2ad1f962b32.name: aria-autocomplete
cc01e2ad1f962b32.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

ed3390e9afac8dc3.name: aria-braillelabel
ed3390e9afac8dc3.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

117ffb582f2070e8.name: aria-brailleroledescription
117ffb582f2070e8.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

530029f33e4c4b44.name: aria-checked
530029f33e4c4b44.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

37680d7ccc2ec026.name: aria-colcount
37680d7ccc2ec026.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

873f25275fe2e432.name: aria-colindex
873f25275fe2e432.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

e94822136fdc58f8.name: aria-colindextext
e94822136fdc58f8.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex.

32b3ff99de8fa48d.name: aria-colspan
32b3ff99de8fa48d.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

ed16b8983988737b.name: aria-controls
ed16b8983988737b.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

ef9f70387b167ee8.name: aria-current
ef9f70387b167ee8.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

2773ceea5ab32112.name: aria-describedby
2773ceea5ab32112.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

376658f2356b08cd.name: aria-description
376658f2356b08cd.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.

858b5670b5e234e3.name: aria-details
858b5670b5e234e3.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

789a8eee0e84d254.name: aria-disabled
789a8eee0e84d254.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

9563cc5e4798789d.name: aria-dropeffect
9563cc5e4798789d.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

920f056a36cd5fd2.name: aria-errormessage
920f056a36cd5fd2.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

28942e96262a1a64.name: aria-expanded
28942e96262a1a64.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

d701fb465ac66c57.name: aria-flowto
d701fb465ac66c57.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

dd0e48968990e20b.name: aria-grabbed
dd0e48968990e20b.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

bbe3f9041df01028.name: aria-haspopup
bbe3f9041df01028.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

6a3aa5bc04c731ac.name: aria-hidden
6a3aa5bc04c731ac.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

d28fee51a67df260.name: aria-invalid
d28fee51a67df260.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

1a3097aa5d7408d0.name: aria-keyshortcuts
1a3097aa5d7408d0.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

503feb1b7d589da6.name: aria-label
503feb1b7d589da6.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

409ea2d35a62fd23.name: aria-labelledby
409ea2d35a62fd23.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

ef48d778a97a1a56.name: aria-level
ef48d778a97a1a56.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

06262ee9c32d807d.name: aria-live
06262ee9c32d807d.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

fb1fbcabdfd58112.name: aria-modal
fb1fbcabdfd58112.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

2ab8a11c00afc910.name: aria-multiline
2ab8a11c00afc910.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

ed0ebb62c3eec7e3.name: aria-multiselectable
ed0ebb62c3eec7e3.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

1045b86094e6eceb.name: aria-orientation
1045b86094e6eceb.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

7f49b00b24379433.name: aria-owns
7f49b00b24379433.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

bb97c13dbc51d667.name: aria-placeholder
bb97c13dbc51d667.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

997ad2119cdc4a75.name: aria-posinset
997ad2119cdc4a75.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

7b88772a07b08f88.name: aria-pressed
7b88772a07b08f88.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

490e8e3713f033f7.name: aria-readonly
490e8e3713f033f7.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

b2904411104cf4ff.name: aria-relevant
b2904411104cf4ff.type: "text" | "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "all" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text additions" | "text removals" | undefined
b2904411104cf4ff.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

ebf989f19a6641b1.name: aria-required
ebf989f19a6641b1.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

ed4f1ee4bdbfbc25.name: aria-roledescription
ed4f1ee4bdbfbc25.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

fe14c23ac238ee19.name: aria-rowcount
fe14c23ac238ee19.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

94a807703c274b63.name: aria-rowindex
94a807703c274b63.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

70984cd66c89d262.name: aria-rowindextext
70984cd66c89d262.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex.

b75e81550b28dc17.name: aria-rowspan
b75e81550b28dc17.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

dd374517e4edf16c.name: aria-selected
dd374517e4edf16c.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

0631ba8dc84c934d.name: aria-setsize
0631ba8dc84c934d.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

04793dc275152af8.name: aria-sort
04793dc275152af8.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

8be89907c1dc0ad4.name: aria-valuemax
8be89907c1dc0ad4.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

1a0c07b6489266de.name: aria-valuemin
1a0c07b6489266de.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

e61078aeb8119a5c.name: aria-valuenow
e61078aeb8119a5c.description: Defines the current value for a range widget.

737d34a9c9b0f6cb.name: aria-valuetext
737d34a9c9b0f6cb.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.

1cb31d3704c92fa0.name: inputMode
1cb31d3704c92fa0.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

e882c536df77f3d5.name: is
e882c536df77f3d5.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

de37aa9732c114a0.name: ref
de37aa9732c114a0.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
